facts.business: Nazara Technologies Limited is a global gaming platform company that develops, publishes, and operates gaming content across mobile, PC, and console platforms, with additional operations in ad-tech and sports media.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on recognition of impairment loss of Rs 98,894 Lakhs on investment in an associate company due to prohibition in offering of online money games pursuant to the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025.

key_risks: Regulatory risk from the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025 impacting online money games
Impairment risk on investments in subsidiaries and associates due to carrying value exceeding share of net assets
Dependence on key gaming IPs and titles for revenue and EBITDA generation
Execution risk in proposed strategic acquisitions (Bluetile and BestPlay) pending approvals
Concentration risk with significant revenue from US market across multiple gaming titles
